entries.text: Tell the FBI agents it's harris. Ray made me give him the name. Owen harris! Ray's going to kill him.

entries.text: No! Owen! No! No!
entries.speaker: Mrs. Harris

entries.text: Daddy!
entries.speaker: Son

entries.text: No! No!
entries.speaker: Wife

entries.text: Owen harris... Don't look away. Look at me.
entries.speaker: Ray Pearce

entries.text: Why are you doing this?
entries.speaker: Owen Harris

entries.text: Because you made me.
entries.speaker: Ray Pearce

entries.text: I don't know what you're talking about.
entries.speaker: Owen Harris

entries.text: Southside salvage.

entries.text: I'm just an accountant.

entries.text: Ray pearce.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: He came here to kill this man but something stopped him, didn't it?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: This man, owen harris-- he begged for his life. It might just have saved him. His attacker got up and ran away.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Makes no sense. Ray pearce was a determined killer looking for someone to blame. Why stop here?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Wherever Ray pearce went the answer to that question went with him but I can tell you why he came after owen harris. It was his name nora found in the file. He was the accountant who authorized the shipment of hazardous materials to southside salvage.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: But if owen harris is the guy Ray holds responsible why'd Ray let him live?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Well, I think that, uh, nora pearce may have been right. Her husband died, or at least his body did. Whatever killed those people was an abomination of a man. It was a machine.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: A machine? Come on, a machine doesn't know blame, agent Scully.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Nor mercy. Unless what drove Ray to kill is also what saved those people. Some flicker of humanity.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
